issue: No explicit 80-percent CUDA process VRAM ceiling
resolution: Added VramResidencyGovernor and cuda_vram_budget_fraction default 0.80 with 0.10-0.95 validation

issue: CUDA OOM could force failure or encourage CPU fallback
resolution: Adaptive microbatch halving retries on CUDA and raises fail-closed after bounded retries; CPU fallback count remains zero

issue: Completed microbatches could require host concatenation
resolution: Added DeviceResidentBatch.concatenate to join completed outputs on-device before one final host materialization

issue: Newton convergence and active-row handling caused CPU synchronization
resolution: Added configurable fixed-shape masked identity systems and fixed damping trials with host_early_exit disabled for resident hot loop

issue: Static zero-impedance validation synchronized runtime CUDA path
resolution: Moved invalid-impedance validation to host preparation before device tensors are executed

issue: PPO loss was copied to CPU after every minibatch
resolution: Loss tensors remain on-device and are materialized once per PPO epoch

issue: PPO CUDA OOM had no bounded resident retry
resolution: Added adaptive current-minibatch halving/retry on CUDA with no learner CPU fallback

issue: VRAM residency policy was not configurable or auditable in GUI/provenance
resolution: Added GUI controls configuration schema and peak/retry/microbatch provenance
